title: Customer Loan Application Form
description: As a customer, I want to submit a personal loan application online so that I can apply for a loan quickly and conveniently.
acceptance_criteria: Form includes all required fields (personal, financial, loan details).
Input validation for all form fields.
Confirmation message displayed upon successful submission.

title: Customer Account Management
description: As a customer, I want to create an account and log in securely so that I can manage my applications and track their status.
acceptance_criteria: User registration flow with email verification.
Secure login functionality for existing users.
Option to reset password.

title: Automated Credit Risk Scoring
description: As the system, I want to automatically assess credit risk using predefined criteria so that I can ensure consistent and objective risk evaluation.
acceptance_criteria: Integrate with a data source (mock/internal) for credit data.
Apply predefined risk rules/model to generate a credit score.
Store the calculated credit score with the application.

title: Loan Decision Recommendation Service
description: As the system, I want to generate an approval or rejection recommendation based on credit risk and policy so that I can automate initial loan decisioning.
acceptance_criteria: Utilize credit score (from US-003) and loan policy rules.
Generate a recommendation (Approved, Rejected, Review).
Store the recommendation alongside the application data.

title: Loan Officer Dashboard - Application List
description: As a loan officer, I want to view a list of all submitted loan applications with key status indicators so that I can quickly identify applications requiring attention.
acceptance_criteria: Display application ID, customer name, loan amount, status, and recommendation.
Filter applications by status (e.g., 'Pending Review', 'Approved').
Sort applications by submission date or status.

title: Loan Officer Dashboard - Application Detail View
description: As a loan officer, I want to access detailed information for a specific loan application so that I can make informed decisions or escalate applications.
acceptance_criteria: Display all submitted application data (personal, financial, loan details).
Show credit risk assessment results and decision recommendation.
Link from the application list to the detailed view.

title: Real-time Application Status for Customers
description: As a customer, I want to view the current status of my submitted loan application so that I can stay informed without needing to contact support.
acceptance_criteria: Display clear application status (e.g., 'Submitted', 'Under Review', 'Approved', 'Rejected').
Status updates reflect the latest state from the backend.
Accessible from customer account dashboard.

title: Comprehensive Audit Logging
description: As the system, I want to automatically record all significant actions and decisions for audit purposes so that I can meet regulatory compliance and provide traceability.
acceptance_criteria: Log user actions (login, application submission, officer decisions).
Log system actions (risk assessment execution, recommendation generation).
Each log entry includes timestamp, user/system ID, action, and outcome.

title: Secure Application Data Storage
description: As the system, I want to securely ingest and store all customer application data so that I can ensure data persistence and availability for processing and review.
acceptance_criteria: Define and implement a database schema for loan applications.
Ensure data encryption at rest for sensitive customer information.
Implement APIs for secure data ingestion and retrieval.

title: Loan Officer Manual Decision Override
description: As a loan officer, I want to manually approve or reject a loan application so that I can exercise human judgment for complex cases.
acceptance_criteria: Button/action on application detail page to change application status.
Option to add a mandatory reason for manual override.
Manual decision is recorded in the audit log (US-008).

title: Core Infrastructure Setup (Dev/Test)
description: As a DevOps Engineer, I want to set up basic development and testing environments so that developers can build and test the system efficiently.
acceptance_criteria: CI/CD pipeline configured for backend and frontend codebases.
Containerized application components (e.g., Docker for backend service).
Accessible database instances for development and testing.

title: UX/UI Design for Customer Application Flow
description: As a UX/UI Designer, I want to design the user interface and user experience for the online loan application so that it is clear, intuitive, and user-friendly.
acceptance_criteria: Deliver wireframes and high-fidelity mockups for the application forms.
Create user flow diagrams for the entire application submission process.
Provide a style guide for customer-facing UI elements.
